create.title: Hard-TOP t=1 character-Poisson scaled product-collar obstruction
create.statement_tex: For the literal t=1 close-factor scalar S_(L,1) over squarefree coprime d_1,d_2 with d_1 odd, d_2<=d_1<=4d_2, and every inherited shell, profile, floor, star, endpoint, and zero-extension convention retained, the exact projector is sum_(a^2|d_1)mu(a) sum_(b^2|d_2)mu(b) sum_(c|(d_1,d_2))mu(c). With Q=[a^2,c], R=[b^2,c], d_1=Qm, d_2=Rn, only Q,m are forced odd and chi_4(Qm)=chi_4(Q)chi_4(m). Exact character Poisson is sum_m chi_4(m)g(m)=(i/2)sum_(s odd)chi_4(s)g_hat(s/4). Its positive saddle is d_1^*=4XQ^2d_2/s^2, with phase XQd_2/s, JQ<=s<=2JQ, literal profile W(XQ/(ys)), and normalized factor 2L^(3/2)J^(-1/2)/(Qd_2). The transform is exactly involutive. The product phase has rank-one Hessian. On every compact smooth interior cell, simultaneous dualization gives s ell=XQR, Q ell<=R s<=4Q ell, and collar |s ell-XQR|<<QRJ/L. One dual coefficient has scale L^(3/2)/(QR sqrt(J)); at most (QRJ/L+1)(XQR)^epsilon factor pairs occur, so termwise positive control has capacity sqrt(JL)X^epsilon=L^(3/2)(H/L+O(L^(-1)))X^epsilon, with the QR decay exactly repaid by collar width. Grouping N=s ell yields a moving near-square chi_4-divisor window; completion to r_2/4 adds an uncontrolled complement. Standard even-step differencing has chi_4(d+2h)chi_4(d)=(-1)^h and loses the character after a positive norm. The audited Bombieri-Iwaniec, Kowalski-Robert-Wu, Robert-Sargos, Duke-Friedlander-Iwaniec, Bettin-Chandee, and Dong-Robles-Zeindler placements do not prove the target after literal coefficient and power restoration; Bettin-Chandee has a formal integral-subcase degenerate placement but an adverse (JL)^(1/2) printed factor. This parks only exact opening followed by termwise positive Poisson control, a second bare transform, standard positive differencing, and these named placements. Literal hard boundaries and the full signed Mobius aggregate remain open. The positive collar is not physical mass, an upper bound for the complete scalar, or a lower bound. No t=1 target, remaining few-point channel, full hard TOP, smooth M2 packet, M9-M2, M9, bridge, quarter theorem, or exponent follows.

reject.reason: The exact character transform and collar identify the first signed aggregate but provide no target-strength cancellation in it.
The sqrt(JL) quantity is a termwise positive smooth-interior route capacity. The physical Mobius and chi_4 signs may cancel, and no coefficient density or lower mass is proved.
The favorable single-opening collar comparison does not sum the exact Mobius openings or own every hard boundary; it is not an upper bound for the complete scalar.
The factor 1/(QR) in one smooth dual coefficient is exactly repaid by the QR factor in the collar width, and positive summation over opening triples remains unpaid.
Completing the near-square chi_4-divisor interval to r_2/4 adds an uncontrolled complementary divisor window and returns to the parked full-divisor interface.
Fourier scaling, the two i/2 factors, and odd character reflection give an exact involution.
For the nonzero even shifts, chi_4(d+2h)chi_4(d)=(-1)^h is constant in d and is lost after a positive norm.

Nonzero zero-extension endpoints can have only reciprocal-frequency decay and saddle-edge transitions require a separate uniform ledger; opened terms need not inherit final physical boundary cancellations.
Bettin-Chandee has a formal one-point-inverse placement on an integral subcase, but its printed (JL)^(1/2) factor and separated coefficient prevent a target-strength use.
Only the audited direct placements are parked; an unexamined or bespoke coefficient-sensitive theorem remains possible.
The compatible L<<D<<L^2, t<<sqrt(L) channels and their near-collision collars remain open even if the t=1 target is later proved.
No hard-TOP parent, M9-M2, M9, or unconditional bridge is closed, so neither the internal one-third theorem nor the external Li-Yang benchmark changes.
